post.message: Quick comms process check: can Facilities Notices standardize the subject line format for campus-wide posts? I’m proposing: "[Facilities Notice] Building – Topic – Date" so the digest and SMS preview are consistent. If folks agree, I’ll update the template and share the guidance doc link here.

Works for me. Also recommending we add a short "Who to contact" line at the bottom (service desk + after-hours number) and keep the first paragraph under 300 characters for mobile. Ryan, send me the draft template and I’ll get it into our SOP binder.

Admin Building note: we’re doing our quarterly conference room inventory next week (chairs, adapters, whiteboard markers). If any departments have “missing items” complaints, please DM me the room number + what’s missing so we can reconcile before the inventory sheet goes to Procurement.

For the new research-track faculty email series: can we add a short reminder about completing COI disclosure + export controls attestation before they request any sponsored project accounts? I’ve had a few late submissions that slow down account setup. Ryan, I can draft copy if you want it in a consistent tone.

Yes please—send 2–3 sentences + a link target and I’ll slot it into Email #2 ("Before Your First Week"). Also: do we want to mention the optional lab safety overview webinar, or keep that in the department-level onboarding packets only?

Orientation logistics: catering needs final headcount by EOD tomorrow. Current RSVP list shows 38 (including 6 spouses/partners). Aisha—can you confirm if we should order 10 extra as buffer? Also, any dietary notes beyond vegetarian/gluten-free that I should flag to the vendor?
Confirming: order +10 buffer. Dietary notes: 2 halal, 1 dairy-free, 1 nut allergy (severe—avoid cross-contact). I’ll update the RSVP sheet and share the final list in this channel once it’s locked.

Planned maintenance this week that may affect operations: **scheduled domestic water shutdown** in the **Admin Services Building (non-research)** on **Thu 6:00–10:00 AM**. Scope is **replacement of several aging isolation valves** on the 2nd-floor riser.

Impacts: no cold/hot water to restrooms, breakrooms, or kitchenette sinks during the window. Elevators and HVAC unaffected. We’ll post **temporary restroom + water service notices** at all entrances and on each floor; custodial will stage signage and direct occupants to nearby open restrooms (Library lobby level).

This is a general facilities ops item (not related to research spaces/lab access).

Thanks Mike. Confirming the Admin Services Building tenant list: HR, Finance, Procurement, and Graduate Programs are the main occupants. I’ll coordinate with floor reps to minimize meetings in the building during 6–10 AM and make sure reception knows to route visitors.

Appreciate the heads-up. Graduate Programs has advising appointments starting at 9:00 AM Thu—if water won’t be back by then, we’ll shift those to Zoom or relocate to the Library. Do we expect full restoration by 10:00?

Yes—target is fully restored by **10:00 AM**. The work is straightforward valve swap-out, but we’re building in time for repressurization + leak checks. If anything slips, I’ll post an update here by **9:15 AM** with a revised ETA.
Quick check for this week’s campus impacts: anything facilities-related that could affect orientation attendees moving around campus?

Only notable item: **Admin Services Building water shutdown Thu 6–10 AM** to replace aging valves (non-research admin building). We’ll have posted notices and alternate restroom directions. No building access restrictions, and it doesn’t touch any research buildings/labs.

Ryan—if you’re sending a weekly onboarding note, please include: Admin Services Building will have no water/restrooms Thu 6–10 AM due to valve replacement; occupants can use Library lobby restrooms. This is unrelated to lab/research spaces.

Drafting comms now. Mike—confirm wording is okay:

“Thu 6–10 AM: Admin Services Building domestic water shutdown to replace aging valves. Restrooms, sinks, and drinking fountains unavailable during this time. Temporary notices will be posted; occupants may use Library lobby restrooms.”
Looks good. Please add “breakroom/kitchenette sinks affected” and “water service will return as soon as work and leak checks are complete (target 10 AM).”
